description: Pattern-similarity values equal to 0.439 pass the filter (at least 0.439).

c.request: Using 0.439 as the cutoff for similarity to illicit patterns (`patsim`), take the advanced behaviour records with high similarity and match each one to its transaction record(s), where `transactionrecord.transreg` equals `advancedbehavior.translink`; drop records with no match. For each order type mix (`ordertypedist`), treating a missing mix as its own group, show the order type mix and the number of matched records. Pattern-similarity values equal to 0.439 pass the filter (at least 0.439).
c.sql: SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.abhvreg) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist;

d.request: Keep only advanced behaviour records with `patsim >= 0.439` (values equal to 0.439 included), inner-join each to `transactionrecord` on `transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink` (dropping unmatched records), then group by `ordertypedist` with NULL as its own group and return each order type mix with its count of matched records.
d.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior a INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;

b.request: Include advanced behaviour records where `patsim >= 0.439` (inclusive), join each to `transactionrecord` on `transreg = advancedbehavior.translink` with an inner join, group by `ordertypedist` with NULL as its own group, and return each order type mix with its count of matched records.
b.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior a INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;
b.raw: Include advanced behaviour records where `patsim >= 0.439` (inclusive), join each to `transactionrecord` on `transreg = advancedbehavior.translink` with an inner join, group by `ordertypedist` with NULL as its own group, and return each order type mix with its count of matched records.

a.request: Take the advanced behaviour records with a similarity to illicit patterns (`patsim`) of at least 0.439 and match each one to its transaction record(s), where `transactionrecord.transreg` equals `advancedbehavior.translink`; drop records with no match. For each order type mix (`ordertypedist`), treating a missing mix as its own group, show the order type mix and the number of matched records.
a.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior a INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;
